detail: Openbank is a division of Santander Bank, N.A. (#29 U.S. bank). Any Santander checking/CD deposits aggregate with Openbank toward the $250,000 limit, and opening requires a mobile device with biometrics enabled.

title: CIT Bank 0.25% cliff below $5,000 + First Citizens FDIC Cert #11063 aggregation
detail: CIT Platinum Savings pays 3.75% base (4.25% w/ BOOST50) only on daily balances >= $5,000, dropping to 0.25% below $5,000, and shares First-Citizens Bank & Trust Co.'s FDIC limit.

title: Barclays 3.65% top tier ($250k+) leaves zero single-owner FDIC interest headroom
detail: Depositing $250,000 to unlock Barclays' 3.65% tier leaves $0 single-owner FDIC room for accrued interest or the $200 bonus. Single-owner insured headroom models use the 3.50% <$250k tier (joint $500k accounts can capture 3.65% fully insured).

title: EverBank 4.20% APY footnote specifies new-account applicability
detail: EverBank's 10/16/2026 disclosure footnotes that 4.20% APY applies to new Performance Savings accounts; savers holding across multi-year horizons should monitor ongoing rate parity.

title: SoFi 3.30% base / 4.40% boosted APY requires ongoing Direct Deposit or $5k/31d deposits
detail: Without qualifying Direct Deposit or $5,000 in qualifying deposits every 31 days, SoFi's savings APY drops from 3.30% to 0.80%.

title: Wells Fargo Platinum 3.25% new-customer tier requires >= $25,000 daily balance
detail: Per the Oct 7, 2026 Consumer Account Addenda (all states except CO), new customers holding >= $25,000 earn 3.25% variable APY, while balances below $25,000 or existing customers earn 0.01% standard APY.

title: U.S. Bank Smartly Savings pays 0.05% standalone vs up to 3.50% w/ relationship bundle
